headline: Executive order lets the military call members of the Ready Reserve to active duty to help address international drug trafficking.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order gives authority to order members of the Ready Reserve of the Armed Forces to active duty. The stated purpose is to address international drug trafficking. No summary was provided, so details such as how many reservists may be called, for how long, and which officials carry out the orders are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the military Ready Reserve
who_it_affects.how: They could be ordered to leave civilian life and serve on active duty for missions related to international drug trafficking.

who_it_affects.group: Families and civilian employers of reservists
who_it_affects.how: They could be affected if a reservist is called to active duty and must leave home or work for a period of time.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 27, 2023; the source does not state a separate effective date.
